source_title: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 Guide to Operational Technology Security
claim_supported: Defines OT as programmable systems and devices that interact with or manage devices interacting with the physical environment and names building automation and physical access control examples.
limitations: Security guidance with unique OT performance reliability and safety context; does not prescribe this facility intervention contract prove any deployment or certify an implementation.

source_title: NIST SP 800-160 Vol. 1 Rev. 1 Engineering Trustworthy Secure Systems
claim_supported: Provides systems security engineering principles activities and tasks including verification validation assurance and lifecycle thinking.
limitations: General systems engineering guidance; does not define a self-storage command protocol physical readback method or safety approval.

source_type: Final NIST Special Publication with 2025 minor release
claim_supported: Provides access control audit configuration management contingency incident response and system integrity control families relevant to explicit authorization accountability recovery and monitoring.
limitations: A control catalog rather than a facility implementation specification; citation does not claim control selection implementation assessment or certification.

source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework AI RMF 1.0
claim_supported: Provides voluntary Govern Map Measure and Manage risk-management functions for organizations designing deploying using or evaluating AI systems.
limitations: Non-sector-specific and voluntary; version 1.0 is being revised and does not certify this method or prescribe facility controls.

source_title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework Generative AI Profile NIST AI 600-1
claim_supported: Provides generative-AI risk considerations and proposed actions across governance content information security human-AI configuration and incident dimensions.
limitations: Cross-sectoral voluntary profile; does not establish model fitness physical-action authority safety or deployment.

claim_supported: Provides outcome-oriented Govern Identify Protect Detect Respond and Recover functions useful for mapping authorization monitoring exception response and restoration practices.
limitations: Voluntary outcome framework; a mapping does not prove conformity security performance or recovery capability.

claim_supported: Defines entities activities agents generation use derivation attribution invalidation and qualified provenance relations for connecting proposal authorization command receipt observation and reconciliation records.
limitations: Domain-agnostic provenance vocabulary; does not establish truth authority sufficient readback physical effect or safe closure.

claim_supported: Defines application-message delivery QoS and acknowledgement flows and states that a QoS 1 receiver need not complete onward delivery before PUBACK.
limitations: Messaging transport semantics stop at the sender-receiver boundary and do not prove controller execution physical effect or governing-state reconciliation.

source_title: RFC 9110 HTTP Semantics Section 9.2.2 Idempotent Methods
claim_supported: Defines HTTP idempotency as the same intended effect on the server for multiple identical requests as for one request and discusses retry boundaries.
limitations: HTTP method semantics do not prove device-level operational idempotency physical effect duration or downstream compensation.

claim_supported: Defines span status as Unset Ok or Error for a traced operation and limits how status should be assigned.
limitations: Mutable observability specification; a span status reflects instrumentation convention and is not physical attestation or governing-state proof.

source_title: OPC UA Part 4 Section 5.3 Service results
claim_supported: Separates service-call status from individual operation StatusCodes and requires clients to inspect operation results even when the service call succeeds.
limitations: OPC UA service semantics are protocol-specific and do not by themselves prove physical effect persistence or sufficient independent observation.

claim_supported: Defines good uncertain and bad StatusCode semantics and diagnostic context for service and operation results.
limitations: A server operation status reports its bounded outcome; it is not automatic evidence of a facility condition or authorization sufficiency.
